visualReview.result: Reviewed actual inventory, dismantling list and confirmation at the checked viewports; shared skin and fixed actions retained.

implementation.scope: Only extra copies; retain one of every equipment ID. Unique growing equipment cannot be dismantled.
implementation.yield: Item required level (fallback item level) selects existing material tier; qualities ordinary/fine/rare/epic/legendary/artifact yield 1/2/3/4/6/8 stones per copy.
implementation.storage: Optional bounded cumulative ledger and matching receipts in existing cultivation state; old saves without the ledger remain compatible.
implementation.dependencies: Reused existing equipment counts, cultivation inventory, SaveStore, i18next and Cocos shared panels; no new dependency or platform API.
